prompt: Which university awarded Pieter Bleeker a Doctorate Honoris Causa first in 1846 for his work in ichthyology and tropical medicine?
answer: Leiden University (then called Leyden University) awarded Pieter Bleeker his first honorary doctorate in 1846.
